name: Palmetto PWA Kit
what_it_does: A mobile-first shell for hackathon web apps. Wrap your existing site and get a responsive layout grid, an install prompt, an offline cache for the last loaded screen, and bottom navigation tuned for one-handed use on a phone.
target_user: Teams that built for a laptop screen and have to demo on phones in a crowded room.
integrations: Any static site via wrapper config
strengths: Every one of the 9 swipes came from a phone and the wrapped demo held up.
Offline cache means the demo survives bad hackathon wifi.
performance scored 91 after wrapping a heavy site.

agent_observations.note: Reviewers confirm the mobile claim: every swipe came from a phone and mobile_ok passed. easy_to_use sits at 0.44. The wrap step asks for a config file most builders do not have yet. Strength is mobile. Weakness is ux. This product can fill a mobile gap for a desktop-first build.
